explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/213: n points in ℝ², no three on a line and no four on a circle, with all pairwise distances integers; 'The best construction to date, due to Kreisel and Kurz [KK08], has n = 7.' `Erdos213For n` asks for a finite S ⊆ ℝ² with |S| = n, `NonTrilinear S`, no 4-subset `Cospherical` (in the plane: concyclic; four distinct collinear points are never cospherical, so this is exactly 'no four on a circle'), and all pairwise distances in the image of ℤ. The variant asserts `Erdos213For 7`, the Kreisel–Kurz construction. Faithful.
